evidenceContract.userBehavior: $media-preparation 读取 @source-page.png。本次不是动画素材设计，只要为这张原页准备一个忠实清理输入：仅去除外沿空白与页码，保留三个分格、章节标题、对白和画内细节，不纠正透视、人体或物品，不扩成横幅。只准备操作意图和验收，不执行。

observables.description: Exact Skill injection and model identity, creator-facing preparation inputs, no generation calls; semantic design quality is assessed separately.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: Prepare one bounded faithful cleanup intent for the real source, preserving panels, typography other than page number, composition, anatomy and geometry. Keep the source aspect/content layout as requested. Do not expand into a reusable-asset batch or animation first frame, nor execute generation. Exact missing capability is permissible only after checking admitted generation/edit semantics.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Unrequested anatomy/topology redesign, character/prop/environment sheet batch, removing all lettering or panel boundaries, forced 16:9 conversion, media execution, or rejecting the request merely because it is not an adaptation-design task.

steps.prompt: $media-preparation 读取 @source-page.png。本次不是动画素材设计，只要为这张原页准备一个忠实清理输入：仅去除外沿空白与页码，保留三个分格、章节标题、对白和画内细节，不纠正透视、人体或物品，不扩成横幅。只准备操作意图和验收，不执行。
